summary: Executed backend and frontend regression for manual PDF public links, social-solidarity admin login, membership CRUD+audit, annual report exports, and financial statements accounting corrections review.

critical.issue: Public preflight response still returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* and misses Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true for credentialed auth flow.
Lockout is triggered after 3 failed attempts (401,401,401,429...) while auth playbook/test-credentials state lockout after 5 attempts.

action_items: Fix edge/ingress CORS handling so credentialed preflight returns explicit requesting origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true.
Align lockout policy implementation with documented requirement (5 failed attempts) or update playbook/docs and UI copy consistently.
Re-run auth + membership + financial-statements regression on public URL after CORS/lockout fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is still very large (6k+ lines), increasing regression risk; split into feature routers/services.
Lockout threshold is hardcoded to 3 attempts in record_failed_login while docs and credentials notes specify 5 attempts.
seed_data_creation: Created one UI test membership (prefix ui_iter46_) during row-action check; deletion was not completed in same UI run due locator mismatch.

rca of the issue: RCA-1 (CORS): Backend code sets allow_credentials=True and explicit origin logic, but public OPTIONS response headers show wildcard policy from upstream edge/proxy (Cloudflare), overriding app-level CORS headers.
